```{python}
#| label: datos-base
#| output: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

dirs = sorted(Path("../lake/serving/indicador_diario").glob("fecha=*/"))
frames = []
for d in dirs:
    try:
        part = pd.read_parquet(d)
        part["fecha"] = d.name.replace("fecha=", "")
        frames.append(part)
    except Exception:
        pass
df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True) if frames else pd.DataFrame()
ult = df["fecha"].max() if not df.empty else "s/d"
base = df[df["fecha"] == ult].copy() if not df.empty else df

def f1(x, dec=1):
    return "s/d" if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)) else f"{x:.{dec}f}"
```

## 01 · Estado de hoy

```{python}
#| label: kpis
#| output: asis
pm = base["pm25_media"].dropna()
lat = base[base["region"] == "LatAm"]["pm25_media"].dropna()
sobre = base[base["pm25_media"] > 35.4].shape[0]
pmax = base.loc[base["pm25_media"].idxmax()] if not pm.empty else None

def card(valor, unidad, etiqueta):
    return (f'<div class="kpi kpi-aire"><div class="kpi-valor">{valor}'
            f'<span class="kpi-unidad">{unidad}</span></div>'
            f'<div class="kpi-etiqueta">{etiqueta}</div></div>')

cards = [
    card(f1(pm.median()), "µg/m³", "PM2.5 mediana · global"),
    card(f1(lat.median()), "µg/m³", "PM2.5 mediana · LatAm"),
    card(str(sobre), "puntos", "Sobre 35.4 µg/m³ (límite diario laxo)"),
    card(f1(pmax["pm25_media"]) if pmax is not None else "s/d", "µg/m³", f'Peor punto · {pmax["ciudad"]}' if pmax is not None else "Peor punto"),
]
print('<div class="kpi-row">' + "".join(cards) + "</div>")
```

## 02 · Visor de PM2.5

Color por categoría OMS 2021, tamaño por concentración.

::: {.map-wrap}
```{python}
#| label: visor-aire
#| fig-cap: "PM2.5 por punto (bandas AQI EPA; línea de referencia: guía OMS 24h ≤ 15 µg/m³)"
import folium
from folium.plugins import MarkerCluster, Fullscreen, MiniMap
from branca.element import MacroElement
from folium.template import Template

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(".").resolve()))
from src.geo.map_components import capas_poligonos, html_leyenda_poligonos

ESRI_SAT = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}"
OMS = {"Buena": "#2d6a4f", "Moderada": "#ee9b00", "Dañina (sensible)": "#ca6702",
       "Dañina": "#bb3e03", "Muy dañina": "#9d0208", "Peligrosa": "#6a040f"}


class EcoLegend(MacroElement):
    """Leyenda como control Leaflet (bottomleft): viaja con el mapa en
    fullscreen y no intercepta el botón (fix position:fixed)."""
    _template = Template("""
        {% macro header(this, kwargs) %}
        <style>
        .eco-legend{background:#fff;padding:0;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;
          line-height:1.45;color:#212529;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.25);max-width:215px}
        .eco-legend details{margin:0}
        .eco-legend summary{cursor:pointer;padding:8px 10px;font-weight:600;list-style:none}
        .eco-legend summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
        .eco-legend summary::after{content:" \\25be";color:#52796f}
        .eco-legend details:not([open]) summary::after{content:" \\25b8"}
        .eco-legend .eco-body{padding:0 10px 8px}
        .eco-legend .eco-hint{margin-top:6px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #e6e8e6;
          font-size:11px;color:#6c757d}
        .eco-legend .dot{font-size:13px}
        </style>
        {% endmacro %}
        {% macro script(this, kwargs) %}
        (function(){
          var mapObj = {{this._parent.get_name()}};
          var leg = L.control({position: 'bottomleft'});
          leg.onAdd = function(map){
            var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'eco-legend leaflet-control');
            div.innerHTML = {{this.html_legend|tojson}};
            L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
            L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
            return div;
          };
          leg.addTo(mapObj);
          mapObj.scrollWheelZoom.disable();
          if (window.innerWidth < 640 && mapObj.dragging) {
            mapObj.dragging.disable();
            mapObj.once('click', function(){ mapObj.dragging.enable(); });
            var d = document.querySelector('.eco-legend details');
            if (d) d.removeAttribute('open');
          }
        })();
        {% endmacro %}
    """)

    def __init__(self, html_legend):
        super().__init__()
        self._name = "EcoLegend"
        self.html_legend = html_legend


def popup(dominio, p, filas):
    """Popup con borde de color por dominio y tipografía Inter."""
    color = {"aire": "#ee9b00", "clima": "#219ebc", "agua": "#01497c"}.get(dominio, "#6c757d")
    rows = "".join(f"<tr><td>{k}</td><td><b>{v}</b></td></tr>" for k, v in filas)
    html = (
        f"<div class='eco-popup' style='border-left:4px solid {color}; "
        f"font-family:Inter,sans-serif; font-size:13px;'>"
        f"<div style='font-weight:700; color:{color}; margin-bottom:6px; border-bottom:1px solid #e6e8e6; padding-bottom:4px;'>"
        f"<b>{p['ciudad']}</b> <span style='font-weight:400; font-size:0.85rem; opacity:0.8;'>({p['pais']})</span></div>"
        f"<table style='width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;'>{rows}</table></div>"
    )
    return folium.Popup(html, max_width=300)


m = folium.Map(location=[-12, -62], zoom_start=3, tiles=None, control_scale=True,
               preferCanvas=True, scrollWheelZoom=False)
folium.TileLayer("OpenStreetMap", name="Calles OSM").add_to(m)
folium.TileLayer(tiles=ESRI_SAT, attr="Esri", name="Satélite").add_to(m)
mc = MarkerCluster(name="PM2.5").add_to(m)
for _, p in base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).iterrows():
    folium.CircleMarker(
        [p["lat"], p["lon"]], radius=4 + min(float(p["pm25_media"]), 150) / 18,
        color=OMS.get(p["categoria_pm25_aqi"], "#6c757d"), fill=True, fill_opacity=0.85,
        tooltip=f"{p['ciudad']}: {p['pm25_media']:.1f} µg/m³ ({p['categoria_pm25_aqi']})",
        popup=popup("aire", p, [("PM2.5", f"{p['pm25_media']:.1f} µg/m³"),
                        ("PM10", f"{f1(p['pm10_media'])} µg/m³"),
                        ("O₃", f"{f1(p['o3_media'])} µg/m³"),
                        ("NO₂", f"{f1(p['no2_media'])} µg/m³")]),
    ).add_to(mc)
mc.add_to(m)

# ---- Capas de polígonos (países, áreas urbanas, cuencas) ----
g_paises, g_urbanas, g_cuencas = capas_poligonos()
if g_paises: g_paises.add_to(m)
if g_urbanas: g_urbanas.add_to(m)
if g_cuencas: g_cuencas.add_to(m)

items = "".join(f"<div><span class='dot' style='color:{c}'>●</span> {k}</div>" for k, c in OMS.items())
items_poly = html_leyenda_poligonos()
EcoLegend(f"<details open><summary>PM2.5 (AQI EE. UU.)</summary><div class='eco-body'>"
          f"{items}<hr style='border:none;border-top:1px solid #e6e8e6;margin:6px 0;'>"
          f"{items_poly}<div class='eco-hint'>Toca el mapa para interactuar · pellizca para zoom</div>"
          f"</div></details>").add_to(m)
MiniMap(toggle_display=True, position="bottomright", width=100, height=100).add_to(m)
Fullscreen(position="topright", title="Pantalla completa",
           title_cancel="Salir de pantalla completa", force_separate_button=True).add_to(m)
folium.LayerControl(collapsed=True).add_to(m)
m
```
:::

## 03 · Análisis

```{python}
#| label: graficos-aire
import plotly.express as px

top = base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]).sort_values("pm25_media", ascending=False).head(20)
fig1 = px.bar(top, x="pm25_media", y="ciudad", color="categoria_pm25_aqi",
              color_discrete_map=OMS, title="Top 20 PM2.5 (µg/m³) · bandas AQI",
              labels={"pm25_media": "PM2.5 media", "ciudad": "Ciudad"})
fig1.add_vline(x=15, line_dash="dash", line_color="#2d6a4f",
               annotation_text="Guía OMS 24h: 15 µg/m³")
fig1.update_layout(height=480, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
fig1.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})

fig2 = px.histogram(base.dropna(subset=["pm25_media"]), x="pm25_media", color="region",
                    nbins=30, title="Distribución de PM2.5 por región",
                    labels={"pm25_media": "PM2.5 µg/m³"})
fig2.add_vline(x=15, line_dash="dash", line_color="#2d6a4f",
               annotation_text="Guía OMS 24h: 15 µg/m³")
fig2.update_layout(height=380, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
fig2.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})
```

> Bandas de color: breakpoints del AQI (EPA EE. UU.). Línea verde: guía OMS 2021 (PM2.5 24h ≤ 15 µg/m³). Bandas calculadas en `src/transform/indicadores.py`.
